name: ComplexFuncBench
intro: ComplexFuncBench针对复杂函数调用设计，涵盖五个真实场景，涉及多步调用和参数约束。要求模型进行长参数填写、参数值推理和处理128k长上下文。基准还提出了自动评估框架ComplexEval，用于量化复杂函数调用任务表现。
build_method: 43个旅行API人工修正, GPT-4o粗生成, 100条资深精标模板, 十倍泛化与初级标注
metric: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
task_type: 复杂函数调用, 多步旅行预订
eval_feature: 多步与约束调用, 参数推理, 长参数, 128K上下文, ComplexEval
task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking
build_method_en: Manual correction of 43 travel APIs, GPT-4o coarse generation, 100 senior-annotated templates, tenfold generalization with junior annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-step constrained calls, parameter reasoning, long values, 128K context, ComplexEval
intro_en: ComplexFuncBench is designed for complex function calls, covering five real-world scenarios involving multi-step calls and parameter constraints. It requires models to handle long parameter filling, parameter value reasoning, and processing 128k-length contexts. The benchmark also introduces an automatic evaluation framework, ComplexEval, to quantify performance on complex function call tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.10132v1 §§2.1–2.2 and §§3.1–3.2, official repository commit c37b284e2f2e03ee456115b7c4b7e537f534be37, and zai-org/ComplexFuncBench dataset revision 5dc7739343f8c87aee465931ba66db13a0fb5dd4. The pinned JSONL has SHA256 be1e0f5951b666f6543b946e915a431a39bbda1807481878eb331245276ac088 and exactly 1,000 rows. Construction starts from 43 corrected Booking.com/RapidAPI functions in five domains. GPT-4o creates 1,000 preliminary queries and paths; senior annotators select 100 relatively complete paths, rewrite queries, add/remove/reorder calls to the shortest complete path, fix type/value/hallucinated/missing parameters, remove overlapping functions, delete ambiguous API responses, and review all templates until no errors. GPT-4o then makes nine new queries per template, junior annotators fill parameters and disambiguate responses, and the original plus nine variants yield 1000 samples: 600 single-domain and 400 cross-domain. ComplexEval performs format checks, bge-large-en-v1.5 cosine/Hungarian mapping, and exact, API-response, or GPT-4o semantic equivalence; matched calls receive annotated responses, unmatched calls receive errors, and the gold call set is updated for the next turn. Success Rate is successful samples / 1000; Call Acc is sum correct calls / sum total calls. GPT-4o separately averages 0/1/2 completeness and correctness scores for valid final responses.
